rationale: pulp ship sign/package/check now run the existing release-artifact forbidden-marker scanner (tools/cmake/PulpReleaseArtifactScan.cmake, unchanged) over the native binaries of the bundles they sign, package or report on, with gates derived from the build cache and SDK provenance; a hit refuses the step, --skip-artifact-scan overrides it loudly. This adds a guard to Pulp's own ship CLI and changes no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority; the packaged artifact's content and layout are unchanged.
